top_signals.title: Stocks Are Overdue for a Pullback, Warns BofA’s Subramanian
top_signals.summary: “It doesn’t feel like a really robust market environment,” says Savita Subramanian, head of US equity and quantitative strategy at BofA Securities. She explains why she expects a pullback in equity markets, despite raising her year-end target for the S&P 500 to 7,400. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: ‘We prefer the US’: Revolut’s Storonksy confirms plan for dual US-UK listing
